senses.zh: 反复；一次又一次；反复地

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7

ex.en: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
ex.zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了日本。

ex.en: Japan has invested in earthquake-resistant buildings to reduce the risks associated with living in a seismically active region.
ex.zh: 日本投资建设抗震建筑，以降低生活在地震活跃地区所带来的风险。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。国名首字母大写，通常不加the；日本人用Japanese。

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.zh: 不同意；不一致；争执；不适宜

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们对于厨房该刷什么颜色意见不一。

ex.en: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
ex.zh: 专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。

col: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法
disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.zh: 变平；变得可比较；成为相等

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

senses.zh: vi. 同意，意见一致；约定，商定
同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定

ex.en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
ex.zh: 我同意你的看法，这汤需要加盐。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.zh: 数以百计的；成百上千；成百上千的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7

senses.zh: 形成；塑造，使成形；使符合

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

col: stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。
📘 8A Unit 7

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

ex.en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
ex.zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。
📘 8A Unit 7

senses.zh: 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物

ex.en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
ex.zh: 可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的投资使各国有可能减少对进口燃料的依赖。

col: make it possible｜使之成为可能
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。常用it is possible to do；不说人is possible to do。

senses.zh: 不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的

ex.en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
ex.zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。

col: impossible task｜不可能完成的任务
make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。

ex.en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
ex.zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

col: the other side of the argument｜争论的另一面
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

ex.en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
ex.zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

ex.en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会期间请将手机调为静音。

ex.en: During periods of extreme heat, local authorities should provide cool indoor spaces for vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 在极端高温期间，地方政府应为脆弱群体提供凉爽的室内场所。

col: during working hours｜在工作时间内
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。during后接名词；while后常接句子；for表示持续时长。

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
ex.zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

senses.zh: 单词；话语；消息；诺言；命令

ex.en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。

ex.en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
ex.zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。

col: word a question carefully｜仔细斟酌问题的措辞
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

senses.en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
the colour of fresh snow or milk
the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked

ex.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。

ex.en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.zh: 奶昔（即泡沫牛奶，将牛奶和冰激凌等混合后搅打至起泡的饮料）

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8
📘 8A Unit 8
📘 8A Unit 8

ex.en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
ex.zh: 我切胡萝卜时，你能帮忙削这些土豆吗？

ex.en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 家庭可以将蔬菜皮制成堆肥而非丢弃，从而减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。

ex.en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
ex.zh: 她把温牛奶倒进一个蓝色的大杯子里。

ex.en: When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
ex.zh: 工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。

col: pour money into｜向……投入大量资金
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。倒入用pour into；倒出用pour out of。

ex.en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。

ex.en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
ex.zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。

col: a pot of yogurt｜一小罐酸奶
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。
📘 8A Unit 8

senses.zh: 对…说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

col: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

ex.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
ex.zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。

ex.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
ex.zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

col: a slice of watermelon｜一片西瓜
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

col: spoon into a bowl｜用勺舀入碗中
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

ex.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
ex.zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。

ex.en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
ex.zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

senses.zh: 增加，添加；补充说；计算…总和

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex.zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

ex.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.zh: 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的
用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
ex.zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。

ex.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
ex.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

col: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

ex.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
ex.zh: 看电影时，我们一起吃了一碗爆米花。

ex.en: Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.
ex.zh: 电影院除了出售电影票，往往还通过销售爆米花等零食获得额外收入。

col: a bowl of popcorn｜一碗爆米花
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。通常是不可数名词；一颗可说a piece of popcorn。

ex.en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
ex.zh: 我们烤了新鲜玉米，配着黄油一起吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing corn may need more efficient irrigation systems as droughts become increasingly frequent.
ex.zh: 随着干旱日益频繁，种植玉米的农民可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。

senses.zh: 机械，机器；机构；机械般工作的人

ex.en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
ex.zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。

ex.en: A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.
ex.zh: 现代机器能高效完成重复性任务，让工人专注于更复杂的问题。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。machine是可数名词；machinery是不可数集合名词。

ex.en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
ex.zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。

ex.en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

senses.zh: 凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞

ex.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。

ex.en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
ex.zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。

col: a hole in the ground｜地上的坑
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。

senses.zh: 夹入；挤进；把...做成三明治

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
ex.zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

ex.en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
ex.zh: 她在一片温热的面包上抹了些黄油。

ex.en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
ex.zh: 用不饱和油脂替代部分黄油，有助于减少饱和脂肪的总体摄入量。

col: a knob of butter｜一小块黄油
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。

senses.zh: 土耳其（横跨欧亚两洲的国家）

ex.en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。

ex.en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
ex.zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

ex.en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
ex.zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。

ex.en: Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
ex.zh: 在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。

col: a head of lettuce｜一棵生菜
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

ex.en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。

ex.en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
a piece of equipment｜一件设备
a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

senses.en: The expression of gratitude, especially in prayer.
A holiday for expressing gratitude, celebrated in the US and Canada.

ex.en: They held a small thanksgiving ceremony after the harvest.
ex.zh: 收获后，他们举行了一场小型感恩仪式。

ex.en: In some countries, Thanksgiving brings families together and encourages reflection on the importance of community support.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，感恩节让家人团聚，也促使人们思考社区互助的重要性。

col: a prayer of thanksgiving｜感恩祷告
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。指节日时首字母大写；泛指感恩时用小写。

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
ex.zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。

ex.en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
ex.zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

senses.zh: 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

senses.zh: 庆祝；举行；赞美；祝贺；宣告
庆祝；过节；举行宗教仪式

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

col: prepare for an exam｜准备考试
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

senses.zh: 肉汁；不法利润；轻易得来的钱

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8

senses.zh: 捣碎的；捣烂的；被捣成糊状的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8

ex.en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
ex.zh: 我们烤了一个南瓜，配米饭一起吃。

ex.en: Growing crops such as pumpkin in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 在社区菜园种植南瓜等作物，可以让城市社区居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。整个南瓜可数；表示作为食材的南瓜时常不可数。

ex.en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。

ex.en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
ex.zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。

col: a slice of pie｜一块馅饼
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

senses.zh: 配制；混淆；使混和；使结交

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。

ex.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
ex.zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

col: a diverse mix｜多样化的组合
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

ex.en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
ex.zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？

ex.en: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
ex.zh: 农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。

col: pepper something with examples｜在某事物中加入大量例子
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

senses.zh: 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
ex.zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。

ex.en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

col: fill in a form｜填写表格
fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

ex.en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
ex.zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。

ex.en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
ex.zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。

col: bake in the oven｜放入烤箱烘烤
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。

senses.zh: 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

col: a plate of rice｜一盘米饭
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

senses.zh: 封面，封皮；盖子；掩蔽物;幌子，借口

ex.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
ex.zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。

ex.en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。

col: cover a topic｜涉及某个话题
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

senses.zh: 服役，服务；适合，足够；发球；招待，侍候
招待，供应；为…服务；对…有用；可作…用

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。

ex.en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: 📘 8A Unit 8。have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.zh: 准备；为…作准备；为…做准备

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
ex.zh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。

ex.en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
ex.zh: 学校在评估学生的整体进步时，应将实践技能与考试成绩一并考虑。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

ex.en: She felt relieved when her final examination was over.
ex.zh: 最后一场考试结束后，她松了一口气。

ex.en: A detailed examination of local housing conditions can help governments identify communities that need urgent support.
ex.zh: 对当地住房条件进行详细调查，可以帮助政府找出急需援助的社区。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

senses.zh: 去看医生；去看病；去医院

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.zh: 可获得的；可购得的；可找到的；有空的

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。available to接使用者；available for接用途。
📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。

ex.en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
ex.zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。

col: until further notice｜直至另行通知
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

senses.zh: 悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决
悬着，垂下；被绞死；悬而不决

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。

ex.en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
ex.zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

col: hang on a wall｜挂在墙上
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

senses.zh: 同“hang”；把上身伸出(窗外)；挂出门外；拖延

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
ex.zh: 你能只用一只手接住球吗？

ex.en: More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 增加公交班次将帮助通勤者赶上接续列车，而不必依赖私家车。

col: catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。过去式和过去分词均为caught；感冒用catch a cold。

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

col: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭
invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

senses.zh: 接受；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

ex.en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
ex.zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。

ex.en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。

col: refuse to do something｜拒绝做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

senses.zh: 前日；昨天；昨天之前的那一天

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

senses.zh: 明天过后；明日之后；末日浩劫

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
ex.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。

ex.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
ex.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。
📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
ex.zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。

ex.en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。

col: an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

senses.zh: 翻下(衣领等)；扭小(灯火等)拒绝考虑；拒绝(某人)

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
ex.zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。

ex.en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
ex.zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。

col: reply to a message｜回复消息
in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

ex.en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
ex.zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。

col: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展
put forward a proposal｜提出建议
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
ex.zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。

ex.en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
ex.zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

senses.zh: 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记
印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样

ex.en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
ex.zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。

col: in print｜已出版且仍可购得
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

senses.zh: 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色）

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9
📘 8A Unit 9
📘 8A Unit 9

senses.zh: 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
ex.zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。

ex.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
ex.zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

senses.zh: 帮助…摆脱困境；救出；协助
帮忙；帮助解决困难；帮助克服困难

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9

ex.en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
ex.zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。

ex.en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
ex.zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

ex.en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
ex.zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。

ex.en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。

col: be glued to a screen｜盯着屏幕看
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。作名词通常不可数；be glued to可指目不转睛地看。

senses.zh: 户外；在外面；没有或不显示某事物

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。

ex.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

col: without saying a word｜一言不发地
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

senses.zh: 使惊奇（surprise的过去分词形式）
感到惊讶的，出人意料的

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

col: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶
surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip: 📘 8A Unit 9。surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。
📘 8A Unit 9

senses.zh: 收到……的来信；收到……来信；收到…的信

tip: 📘 8A Unit 9
📘 8A Unit 9
